tasks.label: Build GTK App
args: gcc -std=c11 gui.c search_engine.c hash.c inverted.c text_processor.c -o mini_search_gui.exe `pkg-config --cflags --libs gtk+-3.0`

tasks.label: Run GTK App
args: set -e; cd '${workspaceFolder}'; echo 'Running in:'; pwd; ls -la mini_search_gui* || true; ./mini_search_gui.exe
